segments.text: businesses often sell different product through the different sales channels ability to activate specific sales channels simplifies workflow and gives you full control on which products will be sold through which channel let's see it in the demo you can set up multiple sales channels in the
Shopify admin on the Shopify sales channels page you can activate any available channels as
needed navigate to products and Export them as Shopify

products then explore the created product in Shopify and check the sales channels to ensure it matches the settings on the Shopify sales channels page if if you haven't configured the Shopify sales channels page your products will default to the online store thank you for watching you can find details about this capability in the release node
also check other videos on Shopify connector enhancements you can find links in the in the description
